content.short: Cypherock X1 is a hardware wallet that removes the seed-phrase single point of failure.
content.description: Cypherock makes the X1, a hardware wallet that splits private keys across multiple cards so there is no single seed phrase to lose, and adds non-custodial crypto inheritance. It is manufactured in India and security-audited. Stable's official ecosystem page lists Cypherock.
content.meta: Cypherock X1 is a hardware wallet with split keys and crypto inheritance, listed in Stable's ecosystem.
